Privacy.pageDescription: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information
Privacy.introduction: We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This privacy policy explains how we handle your data and your rights regarding it.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect information that you provide directly to us, including your name, email address, and any other information you choose to provide. We also automatically collect certain information about your device and how you interact with our services.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content: We use your information to provide and improve our services, communicate with you, and ensure the security of our platform. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You can also object to or restrict certain processing of your data.

dataStorage.title: Data Storage
dataStorage.content: Your data is stored securely on servers located in the European Union. We retain your information only for as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations.

communications.title: Communications
communications.content: We may send you updates about our services, security notifications, and other important information. You can opt out of non-essential communications at any time.

policyUpdates.title: Policy Updates
policyUpdates.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes and obtain your consent where required by law.

dataDeletion.title: Data Deletion
dataDeletion.content: You can request the deletion of your account and associated personal information at any time. Some information may be retained for legal or legitimate business purposes.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact our privacy team at:

Terms.pageDescription: Please read these terms carefully before using our services
Terms.introduction: By accessing or using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you disagree with any part of the terms, you may not access our services.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at:

About.pageDescription: Learn more about our company, mission, and values
About.introduction: Welcome to our platform! We're dedicated to creating a safe, reliable, and user-friendly marketplace for everyone. Our journey began with a simple idea: to connect people and make buying and selling easier than ever before.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.content: Founded in 2023, we started as a small team with a big vision. Today, we've grown into a trusted platform serving millions of users worldwide, helping them buy and sell with confidence.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Our mission is to create a secure and efficient marketplace that empowers users to connect, trade, and build trust in their local communities and beyond.

values.title: Our Values
values.content: We believe in transparency, security, and user satisfaction. Our platform is built on trust, innovation, and a commitment to providing the best possible experience for our users.

security.title: Security First
security.content: Your safety is our top priority. We implement advanced security measures and continuously update our systems to protect your data and transactions.

global.title: Global Reach
global.content: While we started locally, our platform now connects users across multiple countries, supporting various languages and currencies to serve our diverse community.

support.title: 24/7 Support
support.content: Our dedicated support team is available around the clock to assist you with any questions or concerns. We're here to help you have the best experience possible.

achievements.title: Our Achievements
achievements.content: We're proud to have served millions of users, facilitated countless successful transactions, and built a community that continues to grow every day.

future.title: Looking Forward
future.content: We're constantly innovating and improving our platform to better serve our users. Our future plans include enhanced features, expanded services, and continued commitment to excellence.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.content: Have questions or suggestions? We'd love to hear from you!

mainPage.title: The Headless Engine for AI-Powered Marketplaces

mainPage.platformTitle: A Composable Platform for Modern Commerce
mainPage.platformDescription: Five powerful modules that work together seamlessly to create the ultimate marketplace experience.

commerce.title: Commerce Engine
commerce.description: A complete transactional core for multi-vendor marketplaces. Handle payments, orders, shipping, and advanced models like leasing and reservations.

social.title: Social Layer
social.description: Transform transactions into conversations with live messaging, comments, reviews, and user following to build a vibrant, engaged community.

verticals.title: Specialized Verticals
verticals.description: Go beyond simple categories. Deploy feature-rich verticals for Auto, Property, Jobs, Services, and more, each with its own unique logic and data schema.

intelligence.title: AI Co-Pilot
intelligence.description: The intelligent core of your platform. Enable voice commands, image-to-listing creation, and 24/7 autonomous agents for your users and vendors.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: A high-performance foundation built on microservices and Kubernetes. Get enterprise-grade scalability and save costs with our proprietary media and geocoding solutions.

commercePage.title: Commerce Engine
commercePage.subtitle: A complete transactional core for multi-vendor marketplaces. Handle payments, orders, shipping, and advanced models like leasing and reservations.

multiVendor.title: Multi-Vendor Marketplace
multiVendor.description: Complete marketplace infrastructure with vendor management, product catalogs, and automated commission splitting. Support for physical, digital, and service-based products.

payment.title: Advanced Payment Processing
payment.description: Built-in Stripe Connect integration for seamless payment splitting, escrow, and automated payouts. Support for subscriptions, reservations, and custom payment flows.

order.title: Order & Fulfillment Management
order.description: Sophisticated order management with multi-step workflows, shipping integrations, and real-time tracking. Handle complex scenarios like partial fulfillment and returns.

leasing.title: Leasing & Rentals
leasing.description: Support time-based rentals with availability calendars, security deposits, and automated late fee calculations.

reservations.title: Reservations & Bookings
reservations.description: Enable service bookings with slot management, capacity limits, and automated reminder notifications.

subscription.title: Subscription Commerce
subscription.description: Recurring billing with trial periods, plan changes, and automated dunning for failed payments.

auction.title: Auction & Bidding
auction.description: Real-time auction functionality with automatic bid increments, reserve prices, and buy-it-now options.

commercePage.relatedSocial: Add reviews and messaging to your commerce platform
commercePage.relatedIntelligence: Enable voice shopping and smart recommendations

socialPage.title: Social Layer
socialPage.subtitle: Transform transactions into conversations with live messaging, comments, reviews, and user following to build a vibrant, engaged community.

messaging.title: Real-time Messaging
messaging.description: Built on NATS WebSocket for instant communication. Support for direct messages, group chats, and vendor-customer conversations with typing indicators and read receipts.

feeds.title: Activity Feeds
feeds.description: Personalized feeds with complex filtering, infinite scroll, and real-time updates. Show product listings, user activities, and promoted content in a unified stream.

following.title: Follow & Connect
following.description: Build communities around vendors and users. Enable following favorite sellers, brands, or categories with instant notifications for new listings or activities.

reviews.title: Reviews & Ratings
reviews.description: Comprehensive review system with verified purchase badges, photo uploads, and helpful vote tracking. Build trust with authentic user feedback.

comments.title: Live Comments
comments.description: Real-time commenting on listings with threaded discussions, mentions, and moderation tools.

profiles.title: User Profiles
profiles.description: Rich user profiles showcasing activity, listings, reviews, and social connections.

notifications.description: Smart notification system with customizable preferences and real-time push notifications.

socialPage.relatedVerticals: Tailor social features for specific market segments

intelligencePage.title: The Proactive AI Co-Pilot
intelligencePage.subtitle: Our Intelligence Layer is not just a feature; it's the foundation of the user experience. It transforms your platform from a static tool into a dynamic, conversational partner that understands goals, automates tasks, and provides insights.

autonomous.title: The 24/7 Autonomous Agent
autonomous.description: The AI Co-Pilot is proactive. Your users can delegate and schedule complex, multi-step tasks that the AI executes automatically. This turns your platform into an indispensable productivity tool.

multiModal.title: Multi-Modal Interaction
multiModal.description: Radically simplify content creation. Users can interact with your platform using the most natural method for them.

features.image: Image-to-Listing: Upload a photo, and the AI will identify the item, write a description, and suggest a price.
features.voice: Voice Commands: Users can create posts, search, and manage their account entirely hands-free.

conversational.title: Conversational Commerce & Support
conversational.description: Enable users to interact with your platform through natural language. Our dedicated AI Support Agents can handle common customer queries, resolve issues, and provide instant assistance, 24/7. For sensitive data, we leverage privacy-focused models like Anthropic.

analytics.title: AI-Powered Analytics & Insights
analytics.description: The AI doesn't just act; it understands. Your vendors can ask for business insights in plain language and receive actionable reports, helping them sell smarter and grow their business on your platform.

example.query: vave, what was my most viewed item this month, and which search terms brought users to it?

differentiator.title: The Core Differentiator: Contextual Awareness
differentiator.description: Our AI's true power comes from its deep integration with the platform's modular verticals. It is not a generic chatbot. It understands that a "Job" has a "salary" and a "Car" has "mileage." This contextual awareness allows it to provide smarter, more accurate, and genuinely helpful assistance, creating a user experience that is impossible for monolithic platforms with bolted-on AI to replicate.

intelligencePage.relatedVerticals: Context-aware AI that understands each vertical's unique needs

infrastructurePage.title: Enterprise-Grade Infrastructure
infrastructurePage.subtitle: Our platform's foundation is a strategic asset designed for the demands of modern, high-traffic digital marketplaces. We provide the security, performance, and unmatched cost-efficiency you need to scale with confidence.

microservices.title: Microservice Architecture
microservices.description: The platform is a collection of small, independent services written primarily in Go. This prevents cascading failures and allows for rapid, isolated updates without risking platform stability.

apiFirst.title: API-First & Headless
apiFirst.description: Every function is exposed via robust APIs, with high-speed gRPC for internal communication. This gives you ultimate freedom to build any frontend or integrate any service you need.

kubernetes.title: Kubernetes-Powered Scalability
kubernetes.description: We use Kubernetes to orchestrate our services. This enables automated, horizontal scaling on demand. More importantly, we scale verticals independently for maximum performance and cost-efficiency.

media.title: Proprietary Media Management
media.description: Stop paying exorbitant, recurring fees to cloud providers for image and video hosting. Our self-hosted media management solution is built for high throughput at a fraction of the cost, giving you a permanent financial advantage.
media.savings: Typical Monthly Savings vs. AWS S3
media.note: Based on 100,000 images and moderate traffic.

geocoding.title: Proprietary Geocoding Service
geocoding.description: Address verification and map data are essential for multi-vendor marketplaces but are expensive on a per-call basis. Our self-hosted geocoding service eliminates this unpredictable cost, no matter how many vendors or users you have.
geocoding.savings: Typical Monthly Savings vs. Google Maps API
geocoding.note: Based on 10,000-15,000 API calls per month.

performance.title: Performance as a Feature
performance.description: Our lean architecture, compiled Go backend, and efficient gRPC communication result in a platform that is up to 10x faster than comparable monolithic systems built on Shopify or Magento. A faster site means better user engagement, higher conversion rates, and superior SEO rankings.

verticalsPage.title: A Platform of Specialized Verticals
verticalsPage.subtitle: Move beyond simple categories. Our Composable Commerce Engine is built on a foundation of distinct, feature-rich Verticals. Each is a complete, specialized application designed to perfectly match the unique needs of a specific market domain.

advantages.title: The Strategic Advantage
advantages.subtitle: This modular architecture is more than a technical detail—it's your core competitive advantage.

agility.title: Unmatched Business Agility
agility.description: The market changes. With our platform, you can change with it. We can rapidly add new, trending verticals or remove unsuccessful ones (like NFTs) without re-engineering your entire system. This ensures you are always positioned to capture new opportunities.

scaling.title: Efficient, Independent Scaling
scaling.description: A traffic surge on your Jobs board should not slow down your Property listings. Each vertical can be scaled independently, ensuring a flawless user experience and optimizing your infrastructure costs by allocating resources only where they are needed.

VendorsFAQ.pageSubtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions
VendorsFAQ.gs1Question: How long does the application verification process take?
VendorsFAQ.gs1Answer: The verification process typically takes 24-48 business hours. During high-traffic periods, this may extend to 72 hours. You'll receive email notifications at each stage of the process.
VendorsFAQ.gs2Question: What documents are required for registration?
VendorsFAQ.gs2Answer: You need: 1) Current business registration certificate, 2) Tax identification number certificate, 3) Business bank account confirmation, 4) Professional liability insurance (optional but recommended), 5) Product quality certificates (if applicable).
VendorsFAQ.gs3Question: Can I sell as a private individual?
VendorsFAQ.gs3Answer: No, our platform is exclusively for registered businesses. This requires having a business license, tax number, and the ability to issue VAT invoices.
VendorsFAQ.gs4Question: How do I set up my first store?
VendorsFAQ.gs4Answer: After application approval, you'll get access to the seller dashboard with a step-by-step guide. Our dedicated onboarding manager will help you with: company profile setup, adding first products, payment and shipping setup, and AI assistant configuration.
VendorsFAQ.pay1Answer: Commission is automatically deducted from each transaction. Rates: Starter Plan - 8%, Professional Plan - 5%, Enterprise Plan - from 3% (negotiable). Commission covers payment processing, hosting, and all platform features.
VendorsFAQ.pay2Question: When will I receive payment for sold products?
VendorsFAQ.pay2Answer: Standard payout cycle is 7 business days from product delivery. For sellers with 6+ months history, we offer accelerated payouts (2-3 days). Payouts are automatically processed to your business account.
VendorsFAQ.pay3Answer: We accept: credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, bank transfers, BLIK, Google Pay, Apple Pay, installment payments (Klarna, PayPo), and cryptocurrencies (Bitcoin, Ethereum).
VendorsFAQ.pay4Question: Are there additional fees beyond commission?
VendorsFAQ.pay4Answer: Starter Plan has no monthly fees. Professional Plan costs €99/month. We don't charge for: product listings, updates, technical support, photo hosting, SSL certificate. Additional services (e.g., professional photography) are priced separately.
VendorsFAQ.prod1Question: How many products can I list?
VendorsFAQ.prod1Answer: Limits depend on plan: Starter - up to 100 products, Professional - up to 1000 products, Enterprise - unlimited. Each product can have up to 10 photos and unlimited variants (sizes, colors).
VendorsFAQ.prod2Question: How does the offer and promotion management system work?
VendorsFAQ.prod2Answer: You can create: timed promotions (flash sales), discount codes, quantity discounts, bundle offers, loyalty programs. System automatically manages timelines and applies discounts. You can schedule promotions in advance.
VendorsFAQ.prod3Question: Can I import products from other platforms?
VendorsFAQ.prod3Answer: Yes, we offer import via: CSV/XML files, API integration, platform migration (Allegro, Amazon, eBay, Shopify). Our team helps with large product catalog migrations.
VendorsFAQ.ship1Question: Do I have to ship products myself?
VendorsFAQ.ship1Answer: You have two options: 1) Self-shipping - you pack and ship yourself, 2) Fulfillment by Us - we store, pack, and ship your products. Fulfillment service available from Professional plan.
VendorsFAQ.ship2Answer: We work with: DHL, UPS, FedEx, DPD, InPost (parcel lockers), Pocztex, GLS. Automatic label generation, shipment tracking, and negotiated rates for sellers.
VendorsFAQ.ship3Answer: We support shipping to all EU countries. System automatically calculates duties and taxes, generates customs documents. For Enterprise plan, we offer support for global expansion.
VendorsFAQ.ai1Question: How does the personal AI assistant work?
VendorsFAQ.ai1Answer: AI assistant learns about your products and automatically: answers customer questions 24/7, advises on product selection, handles complaints, generates personalized recommendations. Works in 28 languages and integrates with live chat.
VendorsFAQ.ai2Answer: System allows you to program: automatic responses to common questions, product availability notifications, post-purchase follow-up, abandoned cart reminders, seasonal marketing campaigns.
VendorsFAQ.ai3Answer: Yes, you can: train AI on your own data, set communication tone (formal/casual), define business rules, add custom responses, exclude topics. Enterprise plan offers dedicated AI training.
VendorsFAQ.mkt1Question: How does the newsletter system work?
VendorsFAQ.mkt1Answer: You get: drag-and-drop editor, ready templates, audience segmentation, A/B testing, campaign automation, detailed statistics. Contact limits: Starter - 1000, Professional - 5000, Enterprise - unlimited.
VendorsFAQ.mkt2Question: Can I run a blog or content marketing?
VendorsFAQ.mkt2Answer: Yes, each store has built-in CMS for: creating articles and guides, publishing video content, SEO optimization, publication scheduling. Content automatically promoted in search results.
VendorsFAQ.mkt3Question: How does the follower and review system work?
VendorsFAQ.mkt3Answer: Customers can: follow your store, receive notifications about new products, leave reviews with photos/videos, recommend products to friends. Build community and increase customer loyalty.
VendorsFAQ.ana1Answer: Dashboard includes: revenue and margins, conversions and abandoned carts, traffic sources, customer behavior, marketing campaign ROI, competitor analysis, AI sales forecasts.
VendorsFAQ.ana2Answer: Yes, all data can be exported as: CSV, Excel, PDF reports. API access to raw data (Professional+ plan). Integration with Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel.
VendorsFAQ.leg1Question: How does the platform help with GDPR compliance?
VendorsFAQ.leg1Answer: We provide: automatic consents and data management, personal data encryption, data deletion tools, compliance reports, legal support. We regularly update the system according to regulations.
VendorsFAQ.leg2Question: Who is responsible for sales taxes?
VendorsFAQ.leg2Answer: As a seller, you're responsible for tax settlements. Platform provides: automatic VAT invoices, sales reports, accounting system integration, VAT OSS support for international sales.
VendorsFAQ.leg3Question: What are the return and complaint policies?
VendorsFAQ.leg3Answer: You must comply with EU regulations: 14 days for returns without reason, 2 years warranty for defects. System automatically manages return process and generates return labels.
VendorsFAQ.sup1Question: How can I get technical support?
VendorsFAQ.sup1Answer: Support depends on plan: Starter - email (24h response), Professional - live chat + phone (8-20), Enterprise - dedicated 24/7 support. Additionally: knowledge base, video tutorials, webinars.
VendorsFAQ.sup2Answer: Yes, we organize: beginner webinars (weekly), advanced workshops (monthly), individual sessions (Enterprise plan), "Trusted Seller" certification. All recordings available in dashboard.
VendorsFAQ.sup3Answer: We guarantee 99.9% uptime. In case of failures: automatic notifications, real-time status updates, downtime compensation (SLA), priority support for Enterprise plan.
